license.notes: Zoo 1.43.0. The video store's tape racks, for the walker's VHS rental store (MACDADE MOVIES, 2026-10-02): a 1997 strip-mall rental store is walls of boxes faced out under a genre board, low islands down the floor, and a back room behind a curtain. Three forms: wall (shopped from -Y, a genre board a bay: NEW RELEASES, ACTION, COMEDY, HORROR, DRAMA, SCI-FI), island (both faces of a spine, no boards), adult (the wall form for the back room: suggestive, never explicit -- a plain box, a title, a pair of lips, an 18+ badge; no figure). A box is a 12-triangle VHS sleeve, 0.105 x 0.19 x 0.03 m, its front on its title's tile; 36 invented titles (core/video_rack_forms.TITLES). Two submissions whatever the length: painted steel with colour in the Wear vertex colour, and every box and board on one painted image. Collision is the slot's box.
